title: When Can LLM Reasoning Reliably Reuse Intermediate Results?
abstract: arXiv:2610.27662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling complete solutions gives large language models more chances to solve a problem, but each attempt starts again. For tasks with several subproblems, all required answers must be correct in the same attempt. Retaining intermediate results can avoid repeating correct work, but errors in those results may affect later attempts. We study when this reuse is reliable and how much computation it requires. For local retries that stop when no candidate passes within the retry budget, we give conditions for correct completion and bound the average number of attempts. We also show how checking cost and the chance of passing a check affect total computation. Experiments across eight reasoning models examine composite mathematics and arithmetic. Across four DeepSeek models, average success on the second subproblem is 36.2 percent without first-subproblem context, 57.2 percent with its answer, and 58.3 percent with its reasoning and answer. translated_title: 何时大语言模型推理能够可靠地复用中间结果？
translated_abstract: 对完整解进行采样为大型语言模型提供了更多解决问题的机会，但每次尝试都要从头开始。对于包含多个子问题的任务，所有需要的答案必须在同一次尝试中全部正确。保留中间结果可以避免重复已完成的有效工作，但这些结果中的错误可能会影响后续尝试。我们研究了这种复用何时可靠以及需要多少计算量。对于在重试预算内没有候选通过检查时停止的局部重试，我们给出了正确完成的条件，并对平均尝试次数进行了界定。我们还展示了检查成本以及通过检查的概率如何影响总计算量。我们在八个推理模型上对复合数学和算术任务进行了实验。在四个DeepSeek模型上，第二子问题的平均成功率为：无第一子问题上下文时为36.2%，提供其答案时为57.2%，提供其推理过程和答案时为58.3%。
tldr: 该论文从理论上给出了大语言模型可靠复用中间推理结果的条件与平均尝试次数上界，并通过八个推理模型的复合数学实验证明，向后续子问题提供先前子问题的答案（尤其是推理过程和答案）可显著提升成功率（从36.2%提升至58.3%）。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes theoretical conditions under which LLMs can reliably reuse intermediate reasoning results, bounds the average number of retry attempts required, and shows empirically that providing prior subproblem answers—especially with their reasoning—substantially boosts success on later subproblems (from 36.2% to 58.3%).
